name: dust-creek
description: A choose-your-own-adventure western, every picture drawn in code with anidoodle.

scripts.dev: esbuild src/app/dust-creek.ts src/app/corbenic.ts src/app/canicule.ts src/app/grands-bois.ts src/app/library.ts --bundle --outdir=www --entry-names=[name]/app --servedir=www --serve=5180
scripts.build: esbuild src/app/dust-creek.ts src/app/corbenic.ts src/app/canicule.ts src/app/grands-bois.ts src/app/library.ts --bundle --minify --outdir=www --entry-names=[name]/app
scripts.covers: node tools/still.mjs p01 --shot loop --out out/plate-dust-creek.png && node tools/still.mjs c01 --shot loop --out out/plate-corbenic.png && node tools/still.mjs r01 --shot loop --out out/plate-canicule.png && node tools/still.mjs f01 --shot loop --out out/plate-grands-bois.png && for b in dust-creek corbenic canicule grands-bois; do sips -s format jpeg -s formatOptions 80 out/plate-$b.png --out www/covers/$b-plate.jpg >/dev/null && cwebp -quiet -q 85 -m 6 out/plate-$b.png -o www/covers/$b-plate.webp; done
